items.text: A hidden workspace's terminals are sized for the window they will appear in, so they no longer reflow when first shown on a second monitor.
A diff viewer no longer copies a file's patch four times or keeps it after showing it.
The viewer contents card's slide borrows the app's shared GPU device and lets go of its compositor host when the slide ends.
A viewer on glass no longer builds a whole-pane bitmap on every paint.
The viewer find card frees its glass bitmap after its DC, and a test proves rebuilds leave nothing behind.
A HEIC or TIFF in an image pane now decodes off the GUI thread, straight into the response the page reads.
Viewer pages read each file once, straight into the response, and stream video in 2 MB chunks.
Closing a viewer pane no longer freezes the app while its git finishes.
A flooded pane now lets a waiting key or repaint in between every slice of output.
The perf baseline now says what the busy CPU is spent on.
Link hover no longer reads the whole line on every mouse move; plain moves do no link work at all.
A flood of output costs about half the CPU: the ConPTY reader batches it.
Heavy output wakes the renderer once per frame instead of once per read.
